set.body:
Objective
Turn packed storage into a safe experimental module with enforced ownership, checked arithmetic, coherent shape semantics, and a specified representation boundary.

Acceptance criteria
- MutablePackedArray freeze either uses a scoped builder or enforces consumed state.
- All size, stride, word-count, sample-offset, narrow, and sample-to-word arithmetic is checked.
- Shape, scalar, empty-axis, indexing, view naming, and failure semantics are deliberately aligned with core or documented as justified differences.
- Checked and masking constructors have distinct names and tests.
- Iterator ingestion is bounded and any byte serialization format specifies byte order.
- Packed model and state-machine tests pass for 1-, 2-, and 4-bit codes on JVM and Scala.js.
- The module remains 0.x or unpublished until all child tickets close.
set.title: EPIC: Stabilize ravel-packed on an explicit 0.x contract
